entries.Original: Open Sim Menu when entering Inn
entries.Translated: 进入旅馆时打开模拟菜单
显示机制成功/失败标记

entries.Original: Scenarios can only be started from an inn — return to one to run a scenario.
entries.Translated: 情景只能从旅馆启动——返回旅馆即可运行情景。

entries.Original: Scenarios only run in an inn
entries.Translated: 情景只能在旅馆中运行

entries.Original: Cannot start while you are busy (cutscene, NPC event, crafting, trading, zoning, etc.).
entries.Translated: 忙碌时无法开始（过场动画、NPC 事件、制作、交易、切换区域等）。

entries.Original: No strat available for this region yet.
Restart the same scenario immediately after a successful run. A death turns this back off.
entries.Translated: 成功运行后立即重启同一情景。死亡会将其关闭。
场景 - 面板 - 切换

entries.Original: Run without simulated party members or party AI.
entries.Translated: 不使用模拟队友或队友 AI 运行。

entries.Original: Stop the current scenario before changing the run mode.
entries.Translated: 更改运行模式前请先停止当前情景。

entries.Original: Open AnoMech. Subcommands: config, start, reset, leave
